info.title: WiiU Bridge
info.author: Eremosisima
info.description: DSU bridge plugin - allows controlling Wii U from external clients over network
info.details: WiiU Bridge plugin for Aroma. Acts as a DSU (Device State Update) bridge, forwarding controller input from external clients (Android app or PC tools) to the Wii U system. Uses custom protocol (DSUC) over TCP on port 26760. For use with the WiiU Bridge Android client or companion tools from the repository.

changelog:
v23.11.0
- Full DSU protocol + GameCube adapter + merge mode
- Multi-controller support and stability improvements
